run_userscript_before_job: run the UserScript before_job hook to start a background custom script with args and duration
run_userscript_after_job: run the UserScript after_job hook to kill the background process group with SIGINT
run_userscript_background_hook: run the _start_background_hook method to launch a background script with stdout redirection
review_userscript_class: review the UserScript class that extends Hook to manage background script lifecycle before and after jobs
refactor_userscript_before_job: refactor the UserScript before_job method to handle non-background mode script execution
